title: Trajectory-Initialized Neural Double Q-Routing for Large-Scale Overhead Hoist Transport Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.30512v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale industrial robot fleets share constrained physical infrastructure, making vehicle travel times dependent on safety separation, intersection access, downstream blocking, and station contention. We study this problem in overhead hoist transport (OHT) systems, a representative ceiling-mounted material-handling system used in semiconductor fabs. Static shortest-path routing cannot account for these time-varying traffic costs, whereas tabular Q-routing adapts online but learns each destination--node--action value independently, limiting information sharing across sparsely visited routing contexts and making startup behavior sensitive to inaccurate value estimates. We propose Neural Double Q-routing, which replaces destination-indexed tables with a shared state--action value network. The network is warm-started through return-to-go regression on mixed simulator-generated routing trajectories and then refined online using Double-Q

translated_title: 面向大规模空中悬挂传输系统的轨迹初始化神经双重Q路由
translated_abstract: 大规模工业机器人车队共享受限的物理基础设施，使得车辆行驶时间取决于安全间距、交叉口通行权、下游阻塞以及站点争用。我们在空中悬挂传输（OHT）系统中研究这一问题，这是半导体晶圆厂中使用的一种典型的天花板吊装式物料搬运系统。静态最短路径路由无法考虑这些随时间变化的交通成本，而表格型Q路由虽然能够在线自适应，但其对每个“目的地—节点—动作”价值进行独立学习，限制了在稀疏访问的路由情境之间的信息共享，并使启动阶段的行为对不准确的价值估计十分敏感。我们提出神经双重Q路由，用共享的状态—动作价值网络取代以目的地为索引的表格。该网络通过对混合仿真器生成的路由轨迹进行剩余回报回归实现热启动，随后使用双重Q机制进行在线精炼。
tldr: 提出神经双重Q路由方法，用共享的状态—动作价值网络替代按目的地索引的表格型Q值，并通过仿真轨迹的剩余回报回归热启动后在线精炼，解决了大规模OHT系统中稀疏访问路由情境下信息共享不足与启动行为不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Neural Double Q-routing, which replaces destination-indexed Q-tables with a shared state-action value network that is warm-started via return-to-go regression on simulator-generated trajectories and refined online, addressing limited information sharing and unreliable startup behavior in large-scale OHT systems.
